- AI 对话的「附带笔记」更清楚：不附带、已附带（显示笔记名）、左边没有打开笔记三种状态一眼能分辨；发出的消息下面会标出附带了哪篇笔记。
  Clearer "include note" control in AI chat: off, attached (with the note's name) and nothing-open look clearly different, and each sent message shows which note went with it.
- 回复完成后对话不再跳回顶部，停留在最新的消息。
  The chat no longer jumps to the top when a reply finishes; it stays on the latest messages.
- 新增明显的「新对话」按钮，开始一段不接着之前内容的独立对话。
  A labelled "New chat" button starts a fresh conversation that doesn't continue the previous one.
- 代理地址的示例改成通用格式 http://127.0.0.1:端口号。
  The proxy setting's example is now the generic http://127.0.0.1:<port>.
